historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the demolition of a two-story, single-family residence at 570 41st Avenue.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the construction of a three-story, two-unit building at 570 41st Avenue.
A two-story, single-family residence stood at the property.
